tema: Faça a narração em inglês: a casa mal assombrada
legenda: Você teria coragem de encarar os segredos dessa casa assombrada? 👻 Treine seu inglês acompanhando essa história cheia de mistério e suspense. O que você faria no lugar do protagonista? Comente aqui embaixo! #Terror #HistóriasAssustadoras #Mistério #InglêsComHistórias
falas: I entered this abandoned house to save my dog, but the heavy front door slammed shut behind me.
Whispers echoed from the dark hallway, repeating my name even though I had never stepped foot here before.
I followed my dog's barks upstairs, only to find a glowing red door that was not there earlier.
Inside the room, old portraits on the wall turned their eyes directly toward me as the temperature dropped.
My dog was sitting calmly beside a shadowy figure that held a leash identical to my own.
The shadow slowly pointed at a photo frame showing me living in this house eighty years ago.
Would you open the secret cellar door to escape, or stay and uncover your forgotten past?
